exposure: first ANC visit in the second trimester
labor not followed by using partograph
cohort: The study included 418 mothers who gave birth from March 1-30, 2022, in public hospitals in the West Gojjam Zone, Northwest Ethiopia, comprising 105 cases of stillbirth and 313 controls.
finding: The study found that illiteracy, late initiation of ANC, induced mode of delivery, history of stillbirth, bad obstetric history, history of preterm, not being vaccinated for TT, non-utilization of partograph, and history of abortion were significant determinants of stillbirth.
mod_finding: Women who experienced an induced mode of delivery had significantly higher odds of stillbirth (AOR: 8.7, 95% CI: 2.10, 36.03).
